#Loading lab data
```{r}
lab_counts <- read.csv("../data/counts_clean_12192024.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

lab_meta <- read.csv("../data/metadata_clean_12192024.csv", row.names = 1)
```


#Remove unnecessary samples (Pre_Exposure and Control) 
```{r}
filtered_meta_lab <- lab_meta %>%
  filter(
    (is.na(Real_timepoint.x) | Real_timepoint.x != "Pre_Exposure") &
    (is.na(Final_State) | Final_State != "Control")
  )

#write.csv(filtered_meta_lab, "data/filtered_meta_lab.csv", row.names = TRUE)

#Remove the correlated samples from lab_counts
filtered_counts_lab <- lab_counts[, rownames(filtered_meta_lab), drop = FALSE]
```


#Filter out low count genes ##Adjusted numbers until the plots looked how I want
```{r}
#Create gene filter to keep genes with counts >= 20 in at least 10 samples
keep_genes_lab <- rowSums(filtered_counts_lab >= 15) >= 13

#Apply the gene filter to filtered_counts_lab
new_filtered_counts_lab <- filtered_counts_lab[keep_genes_lab, ]

#Output of filtering summary: number and percent of genes removed
cat("Number of genes after filtering:", nrow(new_filtered_counts_lab), "\n")
cat("Percentage of genes removed:", round(sum(!keep_genes_lab) / length(keep_genes_lab) * 100, 2), "%\n")
```

#Determine the proportion of zeroes for filtered and unfiltered lab gene counts
```{r}
#Proportion of zeros before filtering
prop_zeros_before_lab <- sum(filtered_counts_lab == 0) / (nrow(filtered_counts_lab) * ncol(filtered_counts_lab))

#Proportion of zeros after filtering
prop_zeros_after_lab <- sum(new_filtered_counts_lab == 0) / (nrow(new_filtered_counts_lab) * ncol(new_filtered_counts_lab))

cat("Proportion of zeros before filtering:", round(prop_zeros_before_lab * 100, 2), "%\n") #38.47%
cat("Proportion of zeros after filtering:", round(prop_zeros_after_lab * 100, 2), "%\n")   #36.88%
```


#Create plots to compare filtered and unfiltered gene counts
```{r}
#Plot distribution of total counts per gene (log10 scale) before filtering
gene_totals_before_lab <- rowSums(filtered_counts_lab)
hist(log10(gene_totals_before_lab + 1), breaks = 50,
     main = "Gene Expression Distribution (Before Filtering)",
     xlab = "log10(Total Counts per Gene + 1)", col = "purple",
     xlim = c(2,7),
     ylim = c(0,900))

#Plot distribution of total counts per gene (log10 scale) after filtering
gene_totals_after_lab <- rowSums(new_filtered_counts_lab)
hist(log10(gene_totals_after_lab + 1), breaks = 50,
     main = "Gene Expression Distribution (After Filtering)",
     xlab = "log10(Total Counts per Gene + 1)", col = "gold",
     xlim = c(2,7),
     ylim = c(0,900))
```


Check that rows and columns match
```{r}
all(rownames(filtered_meta_lab) %in% colnames(new_filtered_counts_lab))
all(rownames(filtered_meta_lab) == colnames(new_filtered_counts_lab))
```
